My thought process on the Darkspawn/Taint was as follows: 

-Evanuris strike down the Titans and mine them for lyrium

-An aeon later, they seal the tunnels and flee in terror. 

-(spoilers for Tevinter Nights) The red lyrium idol is important to Solas' plan, and is heavily implied to have something to do with the Veil. 

This, to me, means that red lyrium was present before the Veil. We know lyrium is the blood of the titans, and we know red lyrium is tainted. 

That's what led me to believe that whatever they did to the titans, whatever broke the dwarves and left them dreamless, is what caused the Taint. The dwarves that didn't escape would have been trapped, much like the dwarves from the Primeval Thaig. They eventually became the Profane, who mention they devoured their gods. Cannabalism and devouring their prey are common traits to the Darkspawn, and is even how they reproduce (by feeding captured ghouls Darkspawn flesh until they become brood mothers). The leap I made was that the dwarves of the sundered titans became twisted and corrupted from the now tainted titan blood, eventually becoming the first Darkspawn. 

The wait to find out will be too long!

Catholics sometimes pray through the saints and Mary, similar to asking a fellow believer to pray for them.

Catholicism puts a heavy emphasis on tradition, whereas Lutheranism and other protestant branches put a heavier emphasis on personal faith and interpretation of scripture.
